regime.label: Rally
regime.detail: Stocks are rising without pressure from yields.

read: The S&P 500 rose 1.6% on Friday, Nov 27 and rose 1.7% over the past week. The VIX closed at 23.8.
Over the week, the 10-year yield fell 12 bp to 4.94%, oil fell 0.2%, gold fell 1.2%, the dollar rose 0.1%, and chip stocks fell 1.7%.
Strongest sector this week: Materials (+5.5%). Weakest: Semiconductors (−1.7%).
The biggest news themes right now: Trade, tariffs & China, Inflation, jobs & economy, AI & chips.
